design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (age 38, morning and evening oral hydrocortisone therapy, and 6 episodes of vomiting over 3 hours this morning) with an exact 13-word vs 13-word span swap, 11 shared trailing tokens, and zero diagnosis labels.
